comparison.scientific_boundaries: Kim M ancestral state already has an rsmE mucoid mutation; M and D cooperative emergence is NOT direct demonstration of separating two originally optimized functions in one generalist cell. Twenty dry isolates were deliberately chosen from different spreading fans, so 20/20 is not a rate of division-of-labour origin. Zhang 30 selected mutant clone phenotypes are not thirty independent new organ-origin events, nor are F2,7 regression fit statistics WT vs mutant colony mean effects. Higher antibiotic output with mutant investment up to about 50% without observed spore penalty is a colony context, not an empirical BITA K(u) threshold. Both studies use different collective fitness currencies, and no common meta-analytic effect can be pooled or historical ancestral two-function fitness landscape identified.

evidence_direction: new functional collaborator appears within same original colony lineage; not an observed irreversible two-trait architectural switch
independent_reanalysis_claim: F-to-R2 consistency checks for source published per-study regression fits, not new WT interaction-effect estimates
